label: refusal-keyed-property-id
sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT *,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY source_feed,source_epoch,source_delivery_id,property_id,event_ordinal) __members FROM (SELECT hex(encode(source_system,'UTF-8')) AS source_system,hex(encode(entity_kind,'UTF-8')) AS entity_kind,type_id,id,property_id,entity_version,hex(encode(operation,'UTF-8')) AS operation,old_present,hex(encode(old_json,'UTF-8')) AS old_json,new_present,hex(encode(new_json,'UTF-8')) AS new_json,hex(encode(schema_revision,'UTF-8')) AS schema_revision,hex(encode(source_feed,'UTF-8')) AS source_feed,hex(encode(source_epoch,'UTF-8')) AS source_epoch,source_position,event_ordinal,hex(encode(source_time_text,'UTF-8')) AS source_time_text,published_at,hex(encode(apply_batch_id,'UTF-8')) AS apply_batch_id,hex(encode(source_cursor_json,'UTF-8')) AS source_cursor_json,hex(encode(source_delivery_id,'UTF-8')) AS source_delivery_id FROM (SELECT 's' source_system,'edge' entity_kind,cast(7 AS BIGINT) type_id,cast(9 AS BIGINT) id,
 cast(105 AS BIGINT) property_id,cast(16 AS BIGINT) entity_version,'set' operation,true old_present,
 '"é"' old_json,true new_present,'"new"' new_json,'r1' schema_revision,'feed' source_feed,
 'epoch' source_epoch,cast(NULL AS BIGINT) source_position,cast(0 AS BIGINT) event_ordinal,
 cast(NULL AS STRING) source_time_text,cast('2026-10-06 12:00:00.123456' AS TIMESTAMP) published_at,
 'batch' apply_batch_id,'{"xid":"9007199254741101","seq":"9"}' source_cursor_json,'delivery' source_delivery_id))) e FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT *,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY source_feed,source_epoch,source_delivery_id,property_id,event_ordinal) __members FROM (SELECT hex(encode(source_system,'UTF-8')) AS source_system,hex(encode(entity_kind,'UTF-8')) AS entity_kind,type_id,id,property_id,entity_version,hex(encode(operation,'UTF-8')) AS operation,old_present,hex(encode(old_json,'UTF-8')) AS old_json,new_present,hex(encode(new_json,'UTF-8')) AS new_json,hex(encode(schema_revision,'UTF-8')) AS schema_revision,hex(encode(source_feed,'UTF-8')) AS source_feed,hex(encode(source_epoch,'UTF-8')) AS source_epoch,source_position,event_ordinal,hex(encode(source_time_text,'UTF-8')) AS source_time_text,published_at,hex(encode(apply_batch_id,'UTF-8')) AS apply_batch_id,hex(encode(source_cursor_json,'UTF-8')) AS source_cursor_json,hex(encode(source_delivery_id,'UTF-8')) AS source_delivery_id FROM (SELECT source_system AS source_system,entity_kind AS entity_kind,type_id AS type_id,id AS id,cast(106 AS BIGINT) AS property_id,entity_version AS entity_version,operation AS operation,old_present AS old_present,old_json AS old_json,new_present AS new_present,new_json AS new_json,schema_revision AS schema_revision,source_feed AS source_feed,source_epoch AS source_epoch,source_position AS source_position,event_ordinal AS event_ordinal,source_time_text AS source_time_text,published_at AS published_at,apply_batch_id AS apply_batch_id,source_cursor_json AS source_cursor_json,source_delivery_id AS source_delivery_id FROM (SELECT 's' source_system,'edge' entity_kind,cast(7 AS BIGINT) type_id,cast(9 AS BIGINT) id,
 cast(105 AS BIGINT) property_id,cast(16 AS BIGINT) entity_version,'set' operation,true old_present,
 '"é"' old_json,true new_present,'"new"' new_json,'r1' schema_revision,'feed' source_feed,
 'epoch' source_epoch,cast(NULL AS BIGINT) source_position,cast(0 AS BIGINT) event_ordinal,
 cast(NULL AS STRING) source_time_text,cast('2026-10-06 12:00:00.123456' AS TIMESTAMP) published_at,
 'batch' apply_batch_id,'{"xid":"9007199254741101","seq":"9"}' source_cursor_json,'delivery' source_delivery_id)))) a ON e.source_feed <=> a.source_feed AND e.source_epoch <=> a.source_epoch AND e.source_delivery_id <=> a.source_delivery_id AND e.property_id <=> a.property_id AND e.event_ordinal <=> a.event_ordinal WHERE e.__members IS NULL OR a.__members IS NULL OR e.__members<>1 OR a.__members<>1 OR NOT(e.source_system <=> a.source_system) OR NOT(e.entity_kind <=> a.entity_kind) OR NOT(e.type_id <=> a.type_id) OR NOT(e.id <=> a.id) OR NOT(e.property_id <=> a.property_id) OR NOT(e.entity_version <=> a.entity_version) OR NOT(e.operation <=> a.operation) OR NOT(e.old_present <=> a.old_present) OR NOT(e.old_json <=> a.old_json) OR NOT(e.new_present <=> a.new_present) OR NOT(e.new_json <=> a.new_json) OR NOT(e.schema_revision <=> a.schema_revision) OR NOT(e.source_feed <=> a.source_feed) OR NOT(e.source_epoch <=> a.source_epoch) OR NOT(e.source_position <=> a.source_position) OR NOT(e.event_ordinal <=> a.event_ordinal) OR NOT(e.source_time_text <=> a.source_time_text) OR NOT(e.published_at <=> a.published_at) OR NOT(e.apply_batch_id <=> a.apply_batch_id) OR NOT(e.source_cursor_json <=> a.source_cursor_json) OR NOT(e.source_delivery_id <=> a.source_delivery_id)
